manifest.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
manifest.description: Adds a "✨ Enhance prompt" button to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer: rewrites the current draft with the selected model and writes the optimized prompt back.
manifest.author: GAO

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/prompt.js && node scripts/validate.mjs && node --test test/prompt.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# Bundle layer of @local/dsh-prompt-enhancer.
# The Loader inserts one Host row; the same package also ships a `dsh.client`
# browser half that adds the composer toolbar button.
- insert:
    - id: prompt-enhancer
      name: 'dsh-prompt-enhancer'
      config:
        # UTF-8 characters accepted from the composer. Larger drafts are rejected.
        maxInputChars: 8000
        # Output cap for the optimized prompt.
        maxOutputTokens: 2048
        # End-to-end deadline for one optimization call (milliseconds).
        timeoutMs: 90000

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/gw1450048532-arch/dsh-prompt-enhancer/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

A community plugin for **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** that adds an
**「✨ 增强提示词」 / 「✨ Enhance prompt」** button to the chat composer toolbar.
Click it and the current draft is rewritten by the model into a clearer, more effective prompt — then
written straight back into the composer. No session-log entries, no agent turn, no chat noise.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

| Before — one click in the composer toolbar | After — model-optimized prompt written back |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

- **One-click prompt rewrite** from the composer toolbar, next to the `+` and permission controls.
- **Fast auxiliary model call** — uses the profile's default model selection and automatically picks the
  lowest reasoning effort the model advertises (≈ 2 s with `deepseek-flash`).
- **Safe write-back** — replaces the whole draft through the revision-guarded composer API
  (one atomic, undoable edit). If you edit the draft while the request is running, your new text is
  **never overwritten**; the optimized prompt goes to the clipboard instead.
- **Non-destructive** — the call does not append to the session log, does not create a model message,
  and does not start an agent turn.
- **Authenticated local bridge** — the Host endpoint is served through DSH's existing browser-cookie
  `/api` channel; the plugin opens no additional port and adds no unauthenticated route.
- **Configurable** — input/output caps, timeout, system prompt, and provider/model overrides.
- **Bilingual UI** — English and Chinese button/tooltip/notice text plus localized plugin-manager metadata.

- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `0.2.1-rc.3` — the version this plugin was developed and verified against.
- A profile with the Web UI (the desktop app or `dsh web`), and the `llm` service composed (part of
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`).
- Node.js 22+ is bundled with DSH; no build step or external dependency is required.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH.
2. Enter the Git address of this repository:
   `https://github.com/gw1450048532-arch/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
3. Install and make sure the bundle **`dsh-prompt-enhancer`** is enabled.
4. If the plugin row does not appear immediately, restart DSH.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:gw1450048532-arch/dsh-prompt-enhancer

readme.section: then enable the bundle from the Plugins page (or by selecting it in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles)

readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/gw1450048532-arch/dsh-prompt-enhancer.git
```

Then use **Plugins → Add plugin → absolute local path** with the cloned directory, or add a
`link:` dependency to the profile yourself. Note that a workspace-linked package is **not** watched by
DSH's HMR: restart DSH after changing `index.js` / `client.js`.

After installing, the button appears at the left of the composer tool row, after the `+` / mode controls.

1. Type a draft in the chat composer.
2. Click **✨ 增强提示词** (the label follows the app locale).
3. Wait ~1–3 seconds. The draft is replaced by the optimized prompt and a short
   “已回填优化结果 / Optimized prompt applied” notice appears next to the button.
4. Edit the result if needed and send it as usual.

Behaviour details:

- The button is disabled while the draft is empty and shows “优化中… / Enhancing…” while a call runs.
- Only one enhancement runs at a time; a second click is ignored.
- If the draft changed (or the editor became unavailable) while the model was running, the result is
  copied to the clipboard instead of overwriting your text.
- Drafts containing structured reference chips (e.g. `@file` references) are not auto-replaced; the
  clipboard fallback is used to keep the references intact.

All fields are optional with sensible defaults. Override them in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
(the user patch layer), or through the plugin configuration form when your DSH build exposes one:

```yaml

- id: prompt-enhancer
  name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
  config:
    maxInputChars: 8000
    maxOutputTokens: 2048
    timeoutMs: 90000
    # systemPrompt: "Rewrite the user's prompt ..."
    # provider: deepseek-official
    # model: deepseek-flash
```

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxInputChars` | `8000` | Maximum draft length (characters) accepted for optimization. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `2048` | Output-token cap for the optimized prompt. |
| `timeoutMs` | `90000` | End-to-end Host-side deadline for one call. |
| `systemPrompt` | built-in | Overrides the optimization instruction. |
| `provider` / `model` | profile default | Explicit model route for the auxiliary call; both must be set together. |

> The browser half aborts its own request after 150 s, so raising `timeoutMs` above that does not extend
> the effective deadline for the toolbar action.

```
composer (client half)                          Host half
─────────────────────                           ─────────
useInput → draft text
click ✨

- The client uses the standard slot props `useInput` / `inputActions` / `sessionId` from
  `conversation.input.left`; it does not touch the DOM directly.
- The Host registers one exact route on the authenticated Connection fetch channel, so requests are
  authenticated by DSH's existing browser session and never reach a model turn or the session log.
- The model route comes from `ctx.get('agentDefaultModel').currentSelection()` unless overridden.

- The **only** data sent anywhere is the draft text you explicitly submit for enhancement; it goes to the
  model provider configured in DSH, through DSH's regular LLM pipeline.
- No telemetry, analytics, network calls to third-party services, or credential access.
- The local endpoint is served by DSH's own loopback server on the authenticated `/api` channel; the
  plugin adds no new listener and no unauthenticated route.
- See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the threat model and reporting instructions.

DSH is currently a pre-release and its plugin APIs (slots, `InputActions`, `connection.fetch`) may change.
This plugin declares `engines.dsh: ^0.2.1-rc.3`; installing it on a newer DSH release may be refused or
may break until it is updated. Compatibility is verified by the repo's CI (static manifest/bundle checks
plus unit tests) and manually against the pinned DSH release — see
[docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the end-to-end record and the smoke-test checklist.

Maintenance expectations: small, single-purpose plugin; no build step; two runtime source files
(`index.js`, `client.js`) plus a pure helper module (`lib/prompt.js`). If a DSH upgrade breaks it, the fix
is usually confined to `index.js` (route/LLM API) or `client.js` (slot/input API).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gw1450048532-arch/dsh-prompt-enhancer.git
cd dsh-prompt-enhancer
npm run check          # node --check + manifest/resource validation + unit tests
npm test               # unit tests for lib/prompt.js only

There are no runtime dependencies and no build step: the package root is the bundle, `index.js` is the
Host half, `client.js` is the browser module loader factory, and `lib/prompt.js` holds the unit-tested
pure helpers. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the local link-install workflow.

Release checklist: update `CHANGELOG.md` and `version`, run `npm run check`, tag `vX.Y.Z`, publish the
GitHub release using [RELEASE_NOTES.md](RELEASE_NOTES.md) as the template.
